## Summary

Opens Round 2 by repairing the two known defects on the chain tip and
discharging the bookkeeping the backlog catalogue could not express at
REC.1:

1. **The CI parity flake** — PR #104's run
   [`37482844398`](https://github.com/SteveVitali/HarnessHarness/actions/runs/37482844398)
   (`build · test · fmt · drift`) failed once on
   `ac5_attended_and_unattended_share_one_configuration` at
   `.payload.assembly_ms.value` while sibling run `37482834486` passed at
   the same SHA. Root cause: CAP.3 added the measured-wall
   `assembly_ms.{value,measured_at}` fields to one allowlist; this sibling
   comparison was missed. The ac5 allowlist now carries both fields under
   the same `ends_with` convention — semantic differences still reject.
2. **The `hh-kernel doctor` defect (DF-DOC.1-1)** — ruled by **ADR-0332**:
   `KernelDescriptor.version` is the SemVer-class label (the
   `kernel_version_id` tail — the stored field's contract wins; the
   `kernel_floor` compare is defined over bare `x.y.z` triples). The
   self-check now compares through the one canonical extraction
   `hh_embed_schema::kernel_version_label` (CC1). `hh-kernel doctor` exits
   0 on a clean build; a genuine identity mismatch still fails loudly.
3. **The BL-29 verification flips** — DF-S1.3-2, DF-S1.9-4, DF-S1.26-2
   verified against landed code + the amended §7.1 and flipped `DONE` with
   dated evidence; DF-DOC.1-1 also flipped. DF-S1.26-2's closing pass found
   the in-process member-assertion leg missing, so it is landed here
   (`payload.detached == "parked"` on the parked-detach result record —
   the A-1 declared surface).

Requirement ids stamped: `DF-DOC.1-1` · `DF-S1.3-2` · `DF-S1.9-4` ·
`DF-S1.26-2` · `BL-29`; spec touchpoints `R-2.11.1` (parked-detach member,
A-1) · `R-2.12.1` (identity compare).
